title: The team
lead: Who works on this event. Someone you invite gets this event and nothing else in your organization.
listRefused: Only the event’s owner or the organization’s owner can see the team. If you need someone added, ask one of them.

role.unknown: A role this page doesn’t know

COORDINATOR.name: Coordinator
COORDINATOR.about: Runs the event: the door, guests and their contact details, seating, sending messages, the design and the details. Can’t manage the team.

DESIGNER.name: Designer
DESIGNER.about: Shapes the invitation and nothing else. Can’t see the guest list.

VIEWER.name: Viewer
VIEWER.about: Reads the event, its guests without contact details, and the numbers. Changes nothing.

OWNER.name: Owner
OWNER.about: Everything a coordinator can do, and manages this team. Can delete the event.

members.title: On the team
members.none: Nobody is on this team yet.

invites.title: Invitations still open
invites.none: No invitations are open. One that has expired isn’t listed.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.lead: They get an email with a link. Inviting the same address again replaces the earlier link.
invite.doorHelp: Door staff are invited as coordinators, the only role short of owner that can check people in. It also lets them see guests’ contact details and send messages: no narrower role exists yet.

errors.email: That doesn’t look like an email address.

change.title: Change {{name}}’s role
change.body: It applies on their next request. If you change your own role from owner, you can no longer manage this team.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from the team?
remove.body: They’re locked out of this event at once. What they already did stays. If this is you, you lose access too.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the invitation to {{email}}?
withdraw.body: The emailed link stops working. You can invite them again later.

status.invited: The invitation is on its way to {{email}}.
status.sentAgain: A new link is on its way to {{email}}. The earlier one no longer works.

refused.alreadyOnTeam: That person is already on this event’s team. The page has been reloaded.
refused.needsOwner: An event needs an owner. Make someone else an owner first.
refused.activeOwnerOnly: Only someone whose account is active can become an owner.
refused.notOnTeam: That person is no longer on this team. The page has been reloaded.
refused.noPendingInvite: That invitation is no longer open. The page has been reloaded.
refused.gone: This event or person is no longer available. The page has been reloaded.
refused.forbidden: Only the event’s owner or the organization’s owner can manage the team. Ask one of them to do this.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. It may have gone through, so check the list, then try again. An invitation sent again replaces the earlier link.
refused.other: This wasn’t accepted. The reason, in English:
